caption: The worked example run down one column: the RGB triple (255, 128, 0) gives CMY by subtracting each channel from 1, and gives HSV hue 30.1°, saturation 1, value 1 — the bright orange #FF8000. Notice that hue is an angle in degrees, not a 0–255 byte.

spec.title: One pixel, three sets of numbers
spec.aria: A top-to-bottom chain starting from the RGB pixel (255, 128, 0), scaling by 255, taking CMY as one minus each channel to get (0, 0.498, 1) and bytes (0, 127, 255), then converting to HSV (30.1°, 1, 1), labelled bright orange #FF8000.
